scope: Static GGUF metadata inspection, actual installed native-worker comparisons on authored synthetic PT/EN requests in fresh INKLOW_HOME directories, and a separately identified parent-compiled prompt comparison. Parent build/test evidence is separate. No cloud, TCC, normal-model-selection or normal-profile mutation was performed by these quality experiments.

template_comparison.method: Read actual cached GGUF tokenizer.chat_template string and static Rust serialization/tokenizer bridge; did not assume Gemma3 compatibility. Jinja rendering was not performed because Jinja2 is not installed; no dependency installed.

actual_template_lines.bytes: {%- set role = 'model' if message['role'] == 'assistant' else message['role'] -%}

template_comparison.reason: Actual template has separate system role, maps assistant to model, closes normal turns with <turn|> newline and defaults enable_thinking=false. Dense gemma4 emits these same bytes and no thought channel. It must not be rewritten to Gemma3 start_of_turn/end_of_turn.
template_comparison.tokenizer_framing: FramingCache supplies add_bos=false for explicit <bos>-prefixed Gemma families and parse_special=true for trusted framing, avoiding duplicate automatic BOS. Data spans use parse_special=false and data_tokens splits tag-shaped strings so USER_DEFINED channel tokens cannot become control framing. Actual GGUF add_space_prefix=false means these separate span tokenizations do not each acquire an implicit leading space. Native bridge passes booleans directly to llama_tokenize.

candidate.text: Reference facts are optional. Use only facts relevant to the draft and the fixed text after the cursor; ignore unrelated references. Preserve names and uncertainty without copying the reference language or tone.

compiled_comparison.decision: Keep the original prompt and selected Gemma model. Correct the independently demonstrated context handoff defect instead of shipping an unproven wording or model substitution.

limits: Observed transport and correct template framing do not establish semantic quality.

No broad multilingual, user-acceptance or production-quality guarantee is made.

controlled_cached_model_comparison.method: 13 cold fresh-worker cases/model, alternating model order between case pairs; then one matched 13-case warm sequence/model. Exactly one owned worker at a time. max_tokens=32 and explicit max_words=8 with completion_length=long; no model/normal-setting/consent changes. Fresh workers do not flush OS/Metal caches. Uses canonical production sampler through installed app _worker.
